title: Ochrance filesystem verification ↔ JanusKey reversible operations

data_flows.name: a2ml_manifest
data_flows.description: JanusKey's reversible-core emits A2ML manifests that ochrance can verify.

data_flows.name: verification_result
data_flows.description: Ochrance verification results inform JanusKey whether filesystem state is intact.

rules: A2ML manifest format changes require coordinated release
VerifiedSubsystem interface (Idris2) and ReversibleExecutor trait (Rust) must stay aligned

semantic_invariants: Ochrance VerifiedSubsystem and JanusKey ReversibleExecutor represent the same abstraction in different type systems
A2ML manifests emitted by reversible-core must parse cleanly in ochrance's A2ML parser
security_invariants: Hash algorithms must match: both sides use SHA-256 or BLAKE3
No plaintext secrets in A2ML manifests
privacy_invariants: File content never crosses this seam — only hashes and metadata

conformance.notes: Create golden A2ML manifest vectors that both sides parse identically

no_hidden_channels.notes: Verify no implicit state shared beyond A2ML manifests

failure_behavior.retries: No automatic retry — verification is deterministic

backout_steps: Revert A2ML format to previous version
